decision: Do not adopt this fixed-offset prototype; minimum-height approaches in general are not ruled out.

method.input: Vault-guarded Obsidian CLI/CDP, synthetic native pointer sequence and real Obsidian commands
method.ordinaryFoldSamples: 16ms timer plus synchronous before/after samples; not a recording of every painted frame
method.isolatedReflow: Settled measurements after 900px to 500px width change at 700px window height; no frontmatter; short title
method.computerUse: Not performed because the Mac was locked

prototype.strategy: Existing .cm-sizer min-height: calc(100% + captured scrollTop); retain native padding; lower floor on upward scrolling; prepare navigation floor with existing zoom scroll target

existingResizeScript.prototypeAdaptation: Preserve visible-line and position assertions; replace padding >100 assertion with native padding ==100 and inspect computed minimum height

limitations: Native Computer Use clicks were not repeated.
Mobile, headings, blank-area editing, and every-frame paint stability were not validated.
Existing baseline also moved on later widen steps in a separate repeated reflow experiment; the decisive comparison here is only the first narrowing step.
An earlier repeated reflow run stopped on an Obsidian CLI timeout and is excluded from successful checks.
Prototype uses internal scroll-target shape, unmapped pending positions, and DOM-class zoom detection; these need hardening before any retention.
